goal.text: Answer every question about the corpus. The corpus is a FILE in the run dir (see the observation's corpus_path): read it with your own offline tools, it is not in the observation. BANK_FACT {spans} commits several corpus-grounded facts in one action: spans is an array of verbatim substrings, each checked in code, and one missing span refuses the whole action. SUBMIT {answer} answers the current question with a plain string (a value with spaces goes through --params, for example --params '{"answer": "February 2022"}'); it is coverage-gated by the v1 census (>=1 verified span banked for the current question), and those banked spans are its citation. Answers are recorded SEALED and scored only at finalize; during the run the referee grades evidence integrity (span verbatim-presence and coverage), never correctness. WIN = all questions submitted with the census clean.

mode_note: OOLONG query-framed corpus pack, batch banking (the E5 variant, control.bank_mode: batch). Sized for ~25-question packs. Actuators: BANK_FACT, SUBMIT. See bench/oolong/PROTOCOL.md.

actions.name: BANK_FACT
actions.description: bank several facts in one action, each a verbatim corpus span; spans is an array of strings (--params '{"spans": ["...", "..."]}'). Every span is verified as a verbatim substring of the corpus in code; if any is not present the whole action is refused and the attempt is journaled.

actions.name: SUBMIT
actions.description: submit the answer to the current question as a plain string (answer=1 as a token, or --params '{"answer": "February 2022"}' when it holds a space). Coverage-gated: at least one verified span must be banked for this question, and those spans are the citation; on acceptance the answer is sealed and scored only at finalize.
